answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 59043 Country: India Title: Purifying items Question: I masturbate when I cannot control myself. But now I have stopped it but I stopped it just some days ago. But when I used to do that evil act I touched thing with napak hand. My question is how to purify those items (doors, beds, bed-sheets, even my laptop keyboard, smart phone etc) because now I pray 5 times and I totally changed but the thought is sticking that if I touch those which I mentioned before my hand will get napak. So how purify those items? Answer ID: 59043 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 480/445/SN=07/1436) After you had masturbated if your hands were not smeared with semen or madhi or it was smeared but you washed your hands or they dried up then in all these cases nothing turned impure if touched with them. Do not get suspicious. If your hands were smeared with wet impurity (semen or madhi) and you touched anything and the wetness of your hand got smeared with it then the part which is smeared with the impurity only that part shall be considered impure. Laptop, mobile and door etc which are solid and impurity cannot infiltrate inside them then if they are wiped out with anything then shall be pure. Also if they were dried up and the spot of the impurity and effect vanished by rubbing then too these things shall be termed pure. In case you cannot make them pure then too do not worry and do not develop any doubt. As hands shall not be turned impure if they are passed over them save the hands are too wet. However, you can wash the things which are washable i.e. bed-sheet, bed etc. ثوب نجس رطب في ثوب طاهر يابس ، فظهرت رطوبته على ثوب طاهر؛ لكن لا يسيل لو عصر لا يتنجس كما لو نشر الثوب المبلول على حبل نجس يابس ....إلى آخر ما في الدر المحتار (10/454 ، ط: زكريا) وانظر احسن الفتاوى (2/99، 101، ط: زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
